liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (2 reviews, 2 other sources): Reviewer rates this Bird Song as very good; Reviewer thought the Bird Song was nice [4][5][16][18]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Includes the Coca-Cola bridge lyric; the reviewer says it is the only version heard with it; The version with the Coca-Cola bridge is called excellent by the reviewer [2][14][15]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 review): Played as a first-set closer, which the reviewer had long wanted to hear [14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider is called a reliably good show starter [18]
- **Knockin' On Heaven's Door** (1 other source): Attendee on Jerry's side says the opening notes of Knockin' made the moment surreal [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-07.nak300.bleich.sirmick.101018.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1990-09-07.146060.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 187 min [2]
- **gd1990-09-07.158917.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1990-09-07.158698.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd90-09-07.sbd.odeo.13253.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 3.28/5 by 29 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording nice and worth downloading; Vince's keyboards are mixed in nicely on the recording [13][19]

## Around the show

- Fans wondered how the band would sound in its first show after Brent's death [11]
- Vince Welnick's first night with the band; reviewer found him better than expected, trying inventive licks [12]
- Bruce Hornsby's presence was welcomed after the opening shows of this tour [13]
- Reviewer felt the band was a man down and stepped up, yet thought Brent's replacement came too fast [14]
- Reviewer sought out the first show played after Brent's passing and liked the setlist [15]
- Reviewer, who attended Brent's last show at Tinley, drove from Chicago at the last minute; the blotter reportedly disappointed [18]
- Reviewer says fans were freaking out then, yet the band stayed at a career high through 1990 [19]
- Reviewer camped with about 5000 fans half a mile from the hall; this opened a three-night run [21]
- Reviewer felt the band had been peaking from late 1989 into 1990, and this show confirmed it [11]
- Reviewer says Welnick's effort to find interesting licks here is unlike anything heard from him elsewhere [12]
- A ten-song first set was unusual for any show after 1989 [16]
- The following night, 9/8, is called one of the best shows of Fall 1990 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-07.nak300.bleich.sirmick.101018.sbeok.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by SIRMick; source: Nakamichi 300s with cp1 caps > Sony WM-D6 > MAC (Sony Metal-SR) from OTS sec 8, row ccc, seat 3 [1]. Also: Patched from Nakamichi CM-100s with shotguns to Sony D-5, filling gaps on discs 2 and 3 [1]
- **gd1990-09-07.146060.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick Master Digital Recording; transferred by Charlie Miller Transfer Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel; source: Recording info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (110°) > M1000 Cables > Oade Preamp > Master Dat (Panasonic SV-250/48k). Location: (Sect. 2, Row V, Seat 11, mics hand… [2]
- **gd1990-09-07.158917.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 16, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; UltraMatrix, with a patch from Dave Brotman; 2496 downconverted to 1644 [4]
- **gd1990-09-07.158698.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 16, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]
- **gd90-09-07.sbd.odeo.13253.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [7]
